questions.question: Differentiate theory X from theory Y?
questions.solution_html:
• Douglas McGregor developed these theories in the 1960s. The a ppropriate leadership style
  • depends on several factors, including the organization's structure, the type of work, and the skill
  • level of employees.Theory X is based on the assumptions that employees don't really want to
  • work, lack ambition, only work to co llect a paycheck, and need constant supervision. Theory Y
  • is based on the assumptions that employees want to work, want to take responsibility, and do
  • not need much supervision.
